name: Grammarly
tagline: Grammarly is the most widely used AI writing assistant, checking grammar, spelling, punctuation, clarity, and tone across emails, documents, and web browsers. Its premium tier offers full-sentence rewrites, plagiarism detection, and a generative AI assistant that can draft text from scratch. Over 40 million people and 50,000 teams use Grammarly to write with more confidence and fewer errors.
